topics.unverifiedItem: Whether the pain management and opioid use and addiction CE applies at each PA renewal

agreement.text: Since September 16, 2026 a PA attests to a written collaborative agreement at licensure and renewal and gives it to the board on request; PAs at listed facility types or with board authorization may practice without one.

options.text: Two of the three methods: at least 30 contact hours of continuing education (at least 20 from ANCC, ACCME, ACPE, a nurse practitioner or nurse anesthetist certifying body or a board approved sponsor; no more than 10 of in-service education), at least 30 hours of uncompensated professional activities, at least 320 hours of nursing practice
Instead of the methods: a board approved nursing refresher course
Instead of the methods: at least six academic credits toward a nursing degree or certificate beyond the original license
Instead of the methods: passing the NCLEX

notes.text: A nurse first licensed in the second year of the renewal period first meets these requirements before the second renewal.

ce.reason: Renewal requires current national certification in each role and population focus; the board's own contact hours apply only where the certifying body has no CE requirement.
